requestedForUsername.description: The username of the user requesting a password reset

requestedForEmail.description: The email address of the user requesting a password reset

requestedTimestamp.description: The timestamp when the password reset request was made

expirationTimestamp.description: The timestamp when the password reset request will expire

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the password reset request, used in the URI for the user's password reset page

resetCompleted.description: An indicator for whether or not the password reset process has been completed
